why: P2 because it fixes a real, previously reported bug (issue #33715) where ZMQ bind failures were invisible to operators relying on notifications.
Startup abort on misconfiguration is a meaningful reliability and correctness improvement for anyone using -zmqpub*, though it is not consensus- or fund-safety critical.

result.summary: This PR changes ZMQ notifier initialization so that a bind failure (bad address, port already in use, etc.) aborts bitcoind startup with an error-level log message naming the notifier, address, and OS error, instead of silently continuing with a broken ZMQ interface. It threads a util::Result<void> through Initialize()/Create() in the ZMQ notifier classes and init.cpp so the failure reason propagates to InitError. It adds five functional-test cases in interface_zmq.py covering invalid address, partial-success-then-failure, an unreachable IP, and a port already taken by the node's own RPC server, with platform-specific expected error text.
result.problem: Users who configure -zmqpub* addresses get no indication when a bind fails except an invisible debug-level log line, so a node can run for a long time with ZMQ effectively dead while the operator believes it works. Issue #33715 documents exactly this happening when a ZMQ port was already taken.

resolved_concerns: pinheadmz asked that the failure reason be bubbled up to stdout instead of a generic 'Initializing ZMQ interface failed'; author reworked Initialize() to return util::Result<void> carrying the specific reason.

pinheadmz asked for functional tests covering specific expected error messages instead of a loose regex; author replaced the regex with exact string checks and added EADDRNOTAVAIL/EADDRINUSE test cases.
jeanpablojp noted the PR description was stale relative to the code; a documentation nit, not a code concern.

result.card: This PR changes bitcoind so that a ZMQ notifier bind failure (e.g. address already in use, invalid address) aborts startup with an error-level message naming the notifier, address, and OS error, instead of silently continuing with a broken ZMQ setup. It fixes a real reported problem (issue #33715: a taken port left ZMQ silently non-functional) and revives a previously closed PR (#33727). Two reviewers (pinheadmz, jeanpablojp) gave Concept/Approach ACKs after manual and functional testing, and the author addressed all their requests including exact-string functional tests for several errno cases across platforms. No objections are outstanding, and the PR appears Ready for review with no rebase, CI, or stale-author issues. It touches only the ZMQ/RPC area; the util::Result<void> plumbing is incidental to that fix rather than a utils-focused change.
